main_text.l: Christus,ille ἀγαθῶν χρά̈ντωρ, quum his in terris inter Mortales vitam degisset: ut quæ ejus & Apostolorum ætate Iudæis uernacula erat.quod docent voces, Abba, Aceldama, Bar, Bar-aba, Bar-Iesu, Bar jona, Bar-Timi, Bel vel Beel, Beelzebub, Beth abara, Bethania, Bethesda, Beliar, Bene-rehem, Ephphata, Gabbatha, Genesara, Golgatha, Korbona, Mammona, Ribbi, Talitha-Kumi, & alia; quæ merè sunt Syriacæ, & pasim in novo Testamen to occurrunt. In hac lingua extat Translatio totius novi Testamenti vetustissima & elegantissima; ac proinde divinam apud doctiores venerationem habens: quum vel ab Apostolis ipsis, vel à discipulis eorum conscripta credatur. Apostolos Ethnicorum tantùm curam habuisse, Græcè scribendo: suis verò popularibus non consuluisse, vix credibile videatur. Quæ Translatio primùm quidem quatuor EvangeliStarum, deinde verò & epistolarum Apostolicarum, ingenti beneficio Ferdinandi Imperatoris, indefessoq; studio Ioh. Alberti V Vidmanstadii I. C. Germani, petentibus Asiaticis Christianis, juga Libani incolentibus, qui vetere Syrorum linguâ partim vulgò, partim in sacris suis utuntur, Syriacis characteribus & sermone descripta, in aspectum lucemque fuit prolata, Viennæ in Austria, primùm, postea & alibi.
Vide Baum bachiu de antiq. lin guarum orient.

page.notes: Left margin note: "Vide Baum bachiu de antiq. lin guarum orient." is set in small italic type beside the text; it is transcribed as a foot paragraph because it sits at the margin without a reference mark. Line "Iudæis" and "Abba" etc. are Syriac words printed in italic. The printed text of the first Greek phrase is transcribed as printed; the Greek is a best reading and should be checked. Several words in the Syriac list ("Bar-Iesu", "Mammona", "Ioh.") are partly illegible from the scan; [?] was not added to the printed words because the scan reads clearly enough, but the rendering "Bar-Timi" and "Korbona" should be verified. Catchword "TRAN-" at the foot right is copied as printed. Page number not printed.
